profile.headline: Software engineer with four years of experience
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with four years of experience. I have a Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence from Carnegie Mellon University and graduated from the School of Computer Science with University Honors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing a unified software solution for planning, executing, and maintaining datacenter operations.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Software Development and +10 skills

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description:
Rewrote virtual machine allocator to be configurable.

Created a simulator for safely and rapidly testing better allocation algorithms.

Developed a predictive algorithm for VM allocation that reduced simulated pending times for tasks by 81% with only a 31% increase in core usage.

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
Created an open-source webapp for uploading images of receipts and searching through them.

Leveraged Google Cloud ML APIs and wrote custom parsing algorithms to extract transaction dates from 79% of receipts, extract total transaction prices from 95% of receipts, and generate an average of 2.8 relevant categories per receipt.

Designed and implemented a page for displaying and editing extracted receipt info.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Implemented system that allows technicians to manage their workflows when repairing and replacing machines in Google's datacenters.
